@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+package chi
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"net/http"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// MetricsCollector receives one RecordHit call for every request that the
+// router matched to a route, after the route's handler has returned.
+//
+// The router measures the duration itself, so a collector sees the full
+// route pattern (for example "/users/{id}") and the URL parameters that the
+// routing context holds at that point, which middleware placed before the
+// router cannot see. RecordHit is called on the goroutine that serves the
+// request, so an implementation must be safe for concurrent use and should
+// return quickly.
+type MetricsCollector interface {
+	RecordHit(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request, duration time.Duration)
+}
+
+// RouteMetric describes one request that was served by a route.
+type RouteMetric struct {
+	// Pattern is the matched route pattern, such as "/users/{id}".
+	Pattern string
+
+	// Method is the HTTP method of the request.
+	Method string
+
+	// Path is the URL path of the request.
+	Path string
+
+	// Duration is how long the route's handler took to serve the request.
+	Duration time.Duration
+
+	// Params holds the URL parameters of the matched route, keyed by name,
+	// such as {"id": "123"}. It is never nil.
+	Params map[string]string
+}
+
+// SimpleMetricsCollector is a MetricsCollector that turns every hit into a
+// RouteMetric and hands it to the OnHit callback. A SimpleMetricsCollector
+// with a nil OnHit ignores hits.
+type SimpleMetricsCollector struct {
+	// OnHit is called once per matched request. It may be called from many
+	// goroutines at the same time.
+	OnHit func(RouteMetric)
+}
+
+var _ MetricsCollector = SimpleMetricsCollector{}
+var _ MetricsCollector = (*SimpleMetricsCollector)(nil)
+
+// RecordHit builds the RouteMetric of the request and passes it to OnHit.
+// The pattern and the URL parameters come from the routing context in ctx,
+// and are empty when ctx carries none.
+func (c SimpleMetricsCollector) RecordHit(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request, duration time.Duration) {
+	if c.OnHit == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	metric := RouteMetric{
+		Method:   r.Method,
+		Duration: duration,
+		Params:   map[string]string{},
+	}
+	if r.URL != nil {
+		metric.Path = r.URL.Path
+	}
+
+	if rctx := RouteContext(ctx); rctx != nil {
+		metric.Pattern = rctx.RoutePattern()
+		// Later entries come from deeper sub-routers and win, as they do in
+		// Context.URLParam.
+		for i, key := range rctx.URLParams.Keys {
+			if i < len(rctx.URLParams.Values) {
+				metric.Params[key] = rctx.URLParams.Values[i]
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	c.OnHit(metric)
+}

+// SetMetricsCollector sets the collector that is told, after each request this
+// Mux routes to a handler, which route pattern was hit and how long serving it
+// took. Passing nil turns collection off, which is the default and costs
+// nothing per request.
+//
+// Only requests matched to a route are recorded; a request that ends in the
+// not found or method not allowed handler is not. A mounted sub-router records

+// request, including the sub-router's part of the pattern.
+//
+// Like Use, it is meant to be called while the Mux is being set up, before it
+// serves requests.
+func (mx *Mux) SetMetricsCollector(collector MetricsCollector) {
+	mx.metricsCollector = collector
